menu.name: AI Fluency for PK–12 Educators
menu.what: Foundational AI literacy course built with Anthropic: how AI works, safety and privacy, evaluating outputs, bias, academic integrity, age-appropriate use. Creative Commons licensed; completion credential.

menu.name: Orientation & foundational AI training
menu.what: Common baseline training for new AI Region staff and points of contact at program start.

menu.name: AI Hackathons
menu.what: Hands-on builds (90 min–3 hrs) where participants turn a real workflow problem into a working AI prototype (e.g., rubric generator, differentiation tool, parent comms template).
menu.audience: CMs, alumni, staff, board members, college students
menu.cadence: At least 2 per year per region; one on a college campus with Early Talent Recruitment

menu.name: Community of Practice
menu.what: Monthly calls and a shared channel for AI Leads to share what they test, learn and build; MDLDs take part so learning reaches CM support.
menu.audience: AI Leads, MDLDs, recruiters, alumni, CMs

menu.name: Train-the-trainer development & convenings
menu.what: Lab leads events early in the year; regional AI Leads co-facilitate, then lead on their own by spring. Includes the in-person AI Regions convening/retreat.

menu.name: Regional AI app collection + TFA internal app collection
menu.what: Regions capture tools built locally; the strongest feed a shared internal collection (Playlab, PartyRock, Copilot) the Lab designs, tests and documents.
menu.status: Live but early; source notes only a couple of shareable apps at first.

menu.name: Staff facing workshops & office hours
menu.what: Shorter co-designed sessions, e.g., AI ethics workshop at CM training, MDLD virtual Playlab training, monthly tool-building office hours.
menu.status: Offered as example menu items in the AI Regions overview.

menu.name: Storytelling & thought leadership support
menu.what: Press Start newsletter spotlights, videos and social content, co-authored publications and op-eds with regional EDs.
menu.status: Offered; value to regions is still an open question in planning notes.

menu.name: Shared tracking & tool access
menu.what: Shared trackers (e.g., hackathon tracker) and help confirming access to Copilot, Gemini or Playlab.
menu.status: Live; tracking still being tightened for cross-region comparison.

menu.name: Staff AI Playbook (5-step coaching protocol)
menu.what: Protocol for coaches to move from a student-centered friction to a small, testable, human-reviewed AI experiment.
menu.status: Available; being applied in the Boston pilot.

menu.name: Prototype Shop or Pop-Up Event
menu.what: Deeper, longer build experience (1–2 days tested) or a pop-up aligned to regional priorities (e.g., 35th Anniversary plans).
menu.audience: Educators, school & district leaders, alumni, prospects
menu.cadence: At least 1 per year per region
menu.status: Live. Tested in Baton Rouge (22 participants, 33 tools) and Fargo (58 leaders, 41 tools).

menu.name: 5-week AI Leadership Cohort
menu.what: Multi-session "depth" experience aligned to regional priorities; an alternative to the pop-up.
menu.status: Included in the FY27 scope as a programming path.

menu.name: Local fundraising support
menu.what: Help regions raise local dollars for AI initiatives. The Lab covers its own travel but not regional event costs.
menu.status: Program expectation; one of three strategic priorities.
